title: Rise of the Legend
description: A powerful martial arts master (Eddie Peng) returns to the town where his father was murdered to take on a ruthless crime boss (Sammo Hung).

title: Kung Fu Stuntmen
description: Filmmakers showcase the dedication and struggles of kung fu stuntmen and action directors working in Hong Kong cinema during the 1960s-'80s.

title: Deliver Us From Evil
description: An assassin goes to Thailand in order to solve a kidnapping case and finds himself chased by a man whose sibling he killed.

title: Striking Rescue
description: A veteran Muay Thai expert goes on a take-no-prisoners mission of revenge after his wife and daughter are brutally murdered by mysterious forces.

title: The Ming Dynasty Assassin
description: In the waning years of the Ming dynasty, influential eunuch Wei Zhongxian extends his corrupt control over state affairs for selfish gain.

title: Assassins of Brotherhood
description: A secret military organization must ward off a rebellion orchestrated by the Ministry of War.

title: Rising Shaolin: The Protector
description: A con man finds sanctuary with a monk from the long-lost Shaolin Temple.

title: The Paper Tigers
description: Three middle-aged men polish their martial arts skills to avenge their fallen master.

title: Hunt the Wicked
description: Detective Huang Mingjin faces off against criminal mastermind Wei Yunzhou in a city plagued by dark secrets. As police and criminals flood the streets, Huang must unravel the city's sinister core while engaging in a cat-and-mouse game with Wei.

title: Chasing the Dragon
description: Illegal immigrant and drug kingpin Crippled Ho arrives in Hong Kong in 1963. He quickly and ruthlessly builds an underworld empire that's ruled by dealers and corrupt police.

title: Chasing the Dragon II: Wild Wild Bunch
description: The head of a notorious human trafficking gang begins abducting the children of Hong Kong's wealthy elite. Police forces send in an undercover agent to infiltrate the gang and save the hostages.

title: Memories of the Sword
description: A warrior goes on a mission to seek revenge for the death of her parents.

title: Kickboxer: Retaliation
description: One year after avenging his brother's murder, MMA champion Kurt Sloane finds himself imprisoned by a powerful gangster in Thailand. To win back his freedom, he must train for a fight against a 400-pound killer in an underground death match.

title: Police Story: Lockdown
description: While visiting his estranged daughter at a nightclub, a police captain must spring into action when a kidnapping plan unravels right before his eyes.

title: Baby Assassins
description: Two high school girls who are about to graduate also happen to be highly-skilled assassins. When the organization that employs them orders them to share a room, their relationship turns sour.

title: Baby Assassins 2
description: Chisato and Mahiro must pay four years of overdue fees or lose their membership in their assassin guild. They take part-time jobs, but find themselves in the middle of an armed robbery and being hunted by other assassins.

title: Furie
description: A former gang leader battles human traffickers to save her kidnapped daughter.

title: Emergency Declaration
description: Korean authorities discover a terrorist suspect aboard a flight bound for the United States. With steadily decreasing fuel and international refusals to offer aid, the captain and crew take unprecedented emergency measures to save lives.

title: Bad City
description: In poverty-stricken Kaiko City, a corrupt mayoral candidate eliminates rival mafias, prompting a released ex-cop to lead a treacherous battle for justice with a special task force in the gritty underworld.

title: Code of the Assassins
description: Trained by the best, a young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his family's massacre years ago. Failing to complete his mission, he becomes a fugitive hunted by the government and other rival assassins.

description: A former soldier is recruited for his toughest mission yet -- teaching a class of teen delinquents. As he kicks his way into their school and home lives, it becomes clear that his unconventional teaching style might be just what they need.

title: God of War
description: A maverick commander and a young general join forces to battle pirates who pillage small villages in 16th-century China. The violent clash of wits and weapons will ultimately decide who rules the land.

title: God of War 2
description: Benevolent healer Seon-ui discovers a divine medicinal substance called 19; she names it Il-yeo-po, and they become friends until Dong Zhuo's soldiers forcibly seize Il-yeo-po.

title: The Villainess
description: Honed from childhood to be an elite assassin, Sook-hee embarks on a rampage of violence and revenge to finally earn her freedom and escape her past.

title: Shadow
description: To finally achieve victory over a rival kingdom, a brilliant general devises an intricate plan involving his wife, a look-alike and two kings.
